description_en: Performs a paging query for knowledge objects in a knowledge base
description_zh: 分页查询知识库中的知识对象
name: ListKnowledgeObjects

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the knowledge object. Valid values: SEMANTIC_MODEL and DOCUMENT
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

Code.description_en: The business error code. You can use this code to determine the error type when a request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

NextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. The value is null if no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标；没有下一页时为 null

Objects.description_en: The knowledge objects that you have permission to read on the current page
Objects.description_zh: 本页有权读取的知识对象

Content.description_en: The typed content of the knowledge object. The semantic model content or document content is returned based on the Type field
Content.description_zh: 知识对象的类型化内容；按 Type 返回语义模型内容或文档内容

Document.description_en: The document content. This field exists only when Type is set to DOCUMENT

ContentFormat.description_en: The content format. This field is required when Text exists. Valid values in the initial release: MARKDOWN and TEXT
ContentFormat.description_zh: Text 存在时必填，首期 MARKDOWN 或 TEXT

Text.description_en: The publicly accessible body text of the current document. This field is optional. It is omitted when parsing is incomplete, authorization is missing, or the full text cannot be provided completely and securely. A single retrieved snippet is not passed off as the entire document
Text.description_zh: 可公开的当前文档正文，可选；尚未完成解析、未授权或无法完整、安全地提供时省略，不把单个检索片段冒充整篇文档

SemanticModel.description_en: The semantic model content. This field exists only when Type is set to SEMANTIC_MODEL

Datasets.description_en: The logical datasets contained in the model. An empty array is returned if no public datasets are available
Datasets.description_zh: 模型包含的逻辑数据集；没有可公开数据集时为空数组

Description.description_en: The brief description of the object. This field is editable. Pass an empty string to clear the description
Description.description_zh: 简述，可编辑；传空字符串可清空

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. Clients must pass this ID as is and must not concatenate it manually
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID，客户端原样传递，不自行拼接

Fields.description_en: The defined and publicly accessible fields of the dataset. An empty array is returned if no field definitions are provided
Fields.description_zh: 数据集已定义且允许公开的字段；未提供字段定义时为空数组

DataType.description_en: The data type of the field. This field is required for publicly accessible model fields and is not inferred by the server
DataType.description_zh: 字段数据类型；公开的模型字段必须提供，不由服务端猜测

Description.description_en: The brief description of the object. This field is editable. Pass an empty string to clear the description
Description.description_zh: 简述，可编辑；传空字符串可清空

Name.description_en: The user-facing name of the object. This field is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

Name.description_en: The user-facing name of the object. This field is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

PrimaryKey.description_en: The explicitly declared primary key field name. This field is optional. Each item must exist in the Fields of the current dataset
PrimaryKey.description_zh: 已明确声明的主键字段名，可选；每项必须存在于本数据集 Fields

items.description_en: The explicitly declared primary key field name. This field is optional. Each item must exist in the Fields of the current dataset
items.description_zh: 已明确声明的主键字段名，可选；每项必须存在于本数据集 Fields

Metrics.description_en: The executable metrics in the model. An empty array is returned if no metrics are available. Metrics with only candidate formulas are not included
Metrics.description_zh: 模型中可执行的指标；没有时为空数组，不混入只有候选公式的指标

DatasetName.description_en: The name of the semantic dataset to which the metric belongs. This name must be locatable in the Datasets of the current model
DatasetName.description_zh: 所属 SemanticDataset.Name，必须能在本模型 Datasets 中定位

Description.description_en: The brief description of the object. This field is editable. Pass an empty string to clear the description
Description.description_zh: 简述，可编辑；传空字符串可清空

Expression.description_en: The executable expression. It must contain at least one dialect version and is not auto-generated by the model
Expression.description_zh: 可执行表达式，必须包含至少一个方言版本；不由模型补写

Dialects.description_en: The expressions of the same metric in different SQL dialects. At least one item is required. Dialects must not be duplicated
Dialects.description_zh: 同一指标在不同 SQL 方言下的表达式，至少一项；同一方言不重复

Dialect.description_en: The SQL dialect, such as MaxCompute or ANSI_SQL
Dialect.description_zh: SQL 方言，例如 MaxCompute 或 ANSI_SQL

Sql.description_en: The non-empty calculation expression in the specified dialect. This is not a complete query statement
Sql.description_zh: 该方言下的非空计算表达式，不是完整查询语句

Name.description_en: The user-facing name of the object. This field is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

Unit.description_en: The explicitly declared unit of the metric. This field is optional and is not returned when no reliable source is available
Unit.description_zh: 明确声明的指标单位，可选；没有可靠来源时不返回

Relationships.description_en: The defined relationships in the model expressed by field pairs. An empty array is returned if no relationships are available. Relationships are not inferred from graph paths
Relationships.description_zh: 模型内已定义且可用字段配对表达的关联关系；没有时为空数组，不从图路径猜测

FromDataset.description_en: The name of the source semantic dataset

JoinKeys.description_en: The equi-join key pairs for the fields at both ends of the relationship. For composite relationships, fields are paired one by one
JoinKeys.description_zh: 关系两端字段的等值关联配对；复合关联按字段逐项配对

FromField.description_en: The name of the field in the source dataset that participates in the relationship. This field must be defined in the Fields of the dataset corresponding to FromDataset
FromField.description_zh: 起点数据集中参与关联的字段名，须在 FromDataset 对应数据集的 Fields 中定义

ToField.description_en: The name of the field in the destination dataset that participates in the relationship. This field must be defined in the Fields of the dataset corresponding to ToDataset
ToField.description_zh: 终点数据集中参与关联的字段名，须在 ToDataset 对应数据集的 Fields 中定义

Name.description_en: The user-facing name of the object. This field is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

ToDataset.description_en: The name of the destination semantic dataset

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the object was first created

Description.description_en: The brief description of the object. This field is editable. Pass an empty string to clear the description
Description.description_zh: 简述，可编辑；传空字符串可清空

DownloadFiles.description_en: The download items for multi-file specification YAMLs, including file names and temporary download URLs
DownloadFiles.description_zh: 多文件规范 YAML 的下载项，包含文件名与临时下载地址

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the specification YAML file. The validity period is subject to ExpiresIn
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 该规范 YAML 文件的临时下载地址，有效期以 ExpiresIn 为准

FileName.description_en: The original file name of the uploaded document. This field is read-only. Renaming the Name field does not change this value. This field is not returned for external documents and semantic models
FileName.description_zh: 上传文档的原始文件名，只读；重命名 Name 不改变该值；外部文档和语义模型不返回

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the specification YAML file. The validity period is subject to ExpiresIn
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 该规范 YAML 文件的临时下载地址，有效期以 ExpiresIn 为准

Editable.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller has full content editing permissions. The value is true for OWNER and ADMIN, and false for VIEWER. Write operations still require re-authentication
Editable.description_zh: 当前调用者是否具备完整内容编辑权限；OWNER、ADMIN 为 true，VIEWER 为 false，写入仍重新鉴权

ExpiresIn.description_en: The validity period of the knowledge object download URL in seconds. The current value is 300 seconds
ExpiresIn.description_zh: 知识对象下载链接有效期，单位为秒；当前为 300 秒

FileName.description_en: The original file name of the uploaded document. This field is read-only. Renaming the Name field does not change this value. This field is not returned for external documents and semantic models
FileName.description_zh: 上传文档的原始文件名，只读；重命名 Name 不改变该值；外部文档和语义模型不返回

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the object belongs

KnowledgeObjectId.description_en: The ID used to locate the object by type. For semantic models, the modelId from the semantic layer is used. For documents, a stable ID generated by the local document table is used. Callers must not parse the ID or use it as a search ID
KnowledgeObjectId.description_zh: 按类型定位：语义模型沿用语义层 modelId；文档使用本地文档表生成的稳定 ID；调用者不解析 ID，不使用检索 ID

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the current content was last updated
ModifyTime.description_zh: 当前内容最近更新时间

Name.description_en: The user-facing name of the object. This field is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

SizeBytes.description_en: The size of the uploaded original file in bytes. This field is read-only and does not represent the length of the edited body text
SizeBytes.description_zh: 上传原文件的字节数，只读；不是编辑后的正文长度

SourceReferences.description_en: The array of source references. Currently, an empty array is returned
SourceReferences.description_zh: 来源引用数组，当前返回空数组

SourceId.description_en: The source ID. This field exists only when the type is KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE. It represents the SourceId of the KnowledgeSource registered in the current knowledge base
SourceId.description_zh: 仅 KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE 时存在，本库登记的 KnowledgeSource.SourceId

Type.description_en: The category of the source reference. The structure retains KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE. Currently, SourceReferences is an empty array
Type.description_zh: 来源引用类别，结构保留 KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE；当前 SourceReferences 为空数组

Type.description_en: The type of the object. Current valid values: SEMANTIC_MODEL and DOCUMENT. This field is extensible in the future
Type.description_zh: 当前 SEMANTIC_MODEL 或 DOCUMENT；未来可扩展

VersionNo.description_en: The current version of the SEMANTIC_MODEL being read. Pass this value when updating content. The version can be edited in place
VersionNo.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 当前读取的版本；更新内容时传此值，版本可原地编辑

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
